text:
zoe: quick question—should the p95 overlay snap to heatmap bucket centers when sampling is low, or remain a continuous trend line? i'm worried snapping gives a noisy staircase for low-sample windows. :thinking:

marta: i'd keep it continuous for visual trends. snapping could mislead people into thinking latency jumps happened exactly at bucket centers.

jules: continuous + hover markers at bucket centers for exact values. hover markers can show count + bucket p95.

petra: implementation nit: we can compute a confidence score for each p95 point (high if sampleCount > threshold) and render opaque markers only when confidence is high. low-confidence points get a dashed connector.

ben: copy idea for legend badge: "sample density: 0.4/sec (low)" tooltip: "Low density can exaggerate short spikes. Enable 'bucket markers' for exact values." short and actionable.

a11y-bot: accessibility note: when the p95 interpolation changes modes, announce via aria-live: "p95 display set to continuous" so screen readers don't get surprised by plot jumps.

zoe: nice. UX question: where to surface the bucket marker toggle? a) inline legend, b) a small caret menu on the heatmap, or c) within the timepicker as an advanced option?

marta: inline legend is discoverable and keeps controls close to visual. put it as a small icon with aria-label "Bucket markers". clicking opens a mini-panel with Off/Hover/Persistent radio options.

jules: mobile fallback: push options into the timepicker sheet. keep consistency with other density controls.

petra: visual style: when density < 0.5/sec, show a faint stippled overlay on the heatmap and a single-line toast: "Low sample density — some spikes may be exaggerated." Make it dismissible.

ben: analytics: track interactions: bucket_mode_changed, p95_mode_toggled, sample_density_copy_clicked. helps us tune defaults.

a11y-bot: keyboard behavior: radio group must be tabbable and arrow keys switch options. ensure the icon button has a clear focus ring and `aria-expanded` state when the mini-panel opens.

zoe: decision proposal: default p95 continuous; legend icon toggles bucket markers; markers use confidence threshold (server-provided) to show opacity; low-density overlay + small dismissible warning; aria-live announcements for mode changes.

marta: sounds good. thresholds: let's prototype with confidenceThreshold = 30 events per bucket and density overlay threshold = 0.5/sec. we can tweak after telemetry.

jules: small copy tweak: change "Bucket markers" -> "Bucket markers (debug)" to reduce accidental toggles by non-power users? thoughts?

petra: i'd avoid "debug" in copy. maybe "Bucket markers — exact values" which explains purpose.

ben: i'll mock the legend icon + mini-panel and upload a gif. will include keyboard flow and mobile sheet variant.

a11y-bot: reminder: include color contrast checks for marker stroke and focus ring in the PR checklist.

zoe: perfect — thanks. will add this to the design review agenda and include the expected telemetry keys + copy variants. we can finalize thresholds after a small A/B if needed. :thumbsup:
